# Grasp red_block
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_block")
# Choose best candidate (e.g. contact-graspnet or geometry across short axis)
best_cand = max(candidates, key=lambda c: c.get("score", 0))
res = grasp(best_cand)

if res["holding_something"]:
    # Move to purple_box
    obs = observe()
    box = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]
    target_x = box["center"][0]
    target_y = box["center"][1]
    
    # Carry above purple_box (rim_height is 0.05m, carry_to height=0.18 is plenty safe)
    carry_to(target_x, target_y, height=0.18)
    
    # Lower until contact into the box
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)

# Verify
check("red_block", "purple_box")

attempts.code:
# Observe current scene
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Grasp yellow_pen
c = [c for c in grasp_candidates("yellow_pen") if c["fits_open_fingers"]][0]
grasp(c)

# Move high above the holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=0.30)

# The pen was grasped horizontally across its short side (finger_axis along finger direction, side along pen length).
# To make the pen stand upright (pen along vertical world z), we must tilt the gripper so 'side' is along [0, 0, -1] or [0, 0, 1].
# approach x finger_axis = side.
# If approach is horizontal [1, 0, 0] and finger_axis is horizontal [0, 1, 0], side is [0, 0, 1] (or [0, 0, -1] depending on sign).
# Let's test with move_gripper: approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[1, 0, 0] gives side = [0, 0, -1], pointing pen downwards!
# Check IK and move gripper to insert pen vertically into the holder
target_z = table_z + holder["rim_height"] + 0.08
move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[0, 1, 0], finger_axis=[1, 0, 0], path="line")

# Lower down into the cup
move_by(dz=-0.05)
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
